name: Savanna Angels Network (demo)
mandate_text: A group of angel investors backing early Kenyan startups in health, fintech and agriculture that already have a working product.

name: Rift Growth Fund (demo)
mandate_text: A venture fund for startups with revenue in fintech, climate and logistics that are ready to scale across East Africa.

name: HealthBridge Accelerator (demo)
mandate_text: A six-month programme for health startups at idea or prototype stage, investing a small amount for equity alongside mentoring.

name: Climate Tech Seed Programme (demo)
mandate_text: Seed investment for very early climate and clean-energy startups anywhere in Kenya.

name: Mombasa Coast Angels (demo)
mandate_text: Angels from the coast backing startups based in Mombasa, Kilifi and Kwale, especially in tourism, the blue economy and port logistics.

name: AgriGrow Ventures (demo)
mandate_text: Invests in agritech companies that already have paying customers: farm inputs, cold chain and market linkages for smallholder farmers.

name: Lake Region Angels (demo)
mandate_text: Western Kenya angels funding first-time founders around Lake Victoria: fish value chains, farming, schools and clinics.

name: Silicon Savannah Seed (demo)
mandate_text: A seed fund for software startups building business-to-business platforms and SaaS for African companies.

name: Afya Impact Fund (demo)
mandate_text: Invests in health companies with revenue that improve access to care: clinics, diagnostics, pharmacy supply and health records.

name: Jua Kali Makers Angels (demo)
mandate_text: Backs hardware and manufacturing startups: workshops turning local materials into products, solar devices and small machinery.

name: EdTech Launchpad (demo)
mandate_text: A three-month accelerator for education startups: learning apps, school management and skills training for young people.

name: GreenPower Angels (demo)
mandate_text: Funds clean cooking, off-grid solar and e-mobility startups whose customers already pay for the product.

name: Boda Logistics Fund (demo)
mandate_text: Invests in last-mile delivery, boda boda fleet management and transport software with recurring revenue.

name: Pan-African Fintech Partners (demo)
mandate_text: Series A and later investments in payments, lending and insurance technology across Africa.

name: Retail Tech Angels (demo)
mandate_text: Angels backing software for shops, dukas and informal retailers: stock, ordering and payments.

name: Nairobi Founders Syndicate (demo)
mandate_text: A syndicate of operators in Nairobi writing small first cheques into any sector when the team is strong.

name: Shamba Tech Accelerator (demo)
mandate_text: For early agriculture and climate-smart farming startups: irrigation, soil testing, drones and weather data for farmers.

name: Kenya Diaspora Angels (demo)
mandate_text: Kenyans living abroad investing in home-grown startups that have a working product, in any sector.
